editorial.blurb: Mindy's Bakery is a beloved neighborhood spot where flaky pastries, creative seasonal drinks, and thoughtfully made breakfast sandwiches draw devoted crowds willing to wait.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on a weekday morning around 9-10am to skip the weekend rush—Saturday mornings can mean 15+ minute waits, while Thursday or weekday visits offer a calm, unhurried pastry-picking experience.
signatureDishes: weekend breakfast sandwich with mortadella, egg, and Parmesan crust

topDishes.note: buttery and fantastic, a standout draw
